author: Claude (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-11-02, written by hand from each room's object list (category, description, support) in test150detail; not generated by a script or another model
rule: Each task names the objects it needs by id: the object handled, where it is now, where it goes, the furniture the robot works at, and what it must open (articulation). Those objects are required; every other object of the room is expansion.
